title: fix(app-shell): flow screen date, datetime and boolean fields use the platform controls
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb9pHWxyHbH8tpqHHyYnynkk)_
Fixes #26579

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 流程屏幕(screen flow)里的 `date` / `datetime` 字段改用记录表单同一个平台日期选择器(按界面语言显示格式、日历弹层、清除按钮);`boolean` 字段改用 ActionParamDialog 同款的行内勾选行(勾选框在左、标签在右、帮助文字在下)。
- **为什么改:** 流程屏幕是最后一个还在用浏览器原生日期输入框的表单面,中文界面下显示 `mm/dd/yyyy`;布尔字段是标签下面孤零零一个圆形勾选框,看起来像空的单选按钮。hotclm 的「发起合同」向导第一屏就是这样。
- **风险与回滚:** 写回流程的值形状不变(日期 `YYYY-MM-DD`,日期时间为 ISO 时间戳,清空为空串);只有 `datetime` 从前是自由文本框,现在写 ISO 时间戳。三个控件都经懒加载,首次出现有一帧占位。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx` 中 `ScreenFieldInput` 新增的 date/datetime 与 boolean 两段,以及 `ScreenView` 里 `isBooleanScreenField` 的行内行布局。
- **两分钟验证:** 在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.platformControls-26579.test.tsx`,应见 13 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ScreenFieldInput` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx`) drew a flow screen's `date` field as the browser's native `type="date"` input, a `datetime` field as a bare text box, and a `boolean` / `checkbox` field as a lone `Checkbox` under the generic label. It now reuses the platform controls, with no third widget:

- **`date` / `datetime`** render the record form's picker, `DatePickerField` / `DateTimePickerField` (objectui#12622), reached through `getLazyFieldWidget('date' | 'datetime')` exactly as `ActionParamDialog`'s date params reach it. The text box is in the display locale's format, with the calendar popover, clear and today / tomorrow shortcuts. The value handed to the runner is the stored shape: `YYYY-MM-DD` for `date` (as the native input wrote), an ISO instant for `datetime`, and `''` when cleared.
- **`boolean` / `checkbox`** render `ActionParamDialog`'s inline row: the form's `BooleanField` in its checkbox face (`getLazyFieldWidget('boolean')` with `widget: 'checkbox'`, the field `paramToField` hands the dialog), the label beside the control and the help text under the row. The host passes the id, so the widget draws no second `sr-only` label. A boolean field that declares `options` is still a select with its label above.
- `aria-required` and `aria-describedby` (the `inlineHelpText` link) ride the state channel to the new controls as before.
- The `min` / `max` comment drops the date-input clause: no arm draws a native date input any more.

The real producer is the one the card names, `ScreenFieldInput`; nothing outside `ScreenView.tsx` changes in source. `FlowRunner.tsx` is untouched.

## Why

Record forms moved to the platform date picker (objectui#12622) and action dialogs, list filters and inline editors followed. Flow screens did not, so a screen flow (the hotclm 发起合同 wizard was the measured case) showed `mm/dd/yyyy` under zh-CN and a boolean that read like an empty radio button.

## Tests

- New `ScreenView.platformControls-26579.test.tsx` (13 tests): the date picker replaces `input[type=date]`, shows `10/16/2026` in en and `2026/10/16` with the `YYYY/MM/DD` placeholder in zh, writes the ISO day for typed text and `''` on clear, and keeps `aria-required` and the help description; the date-time picker writes an ISO instant; the boolean row puts the label beside the checkbox (control first), a `checkbox` hint draws the same row, ticking answers `true` and clicking the label unticks to `false`, only a real `true` is checked, the required marker and help text sit where they should, one label per control, and a boolean with `options` stays a select (control).
- Updated pins that read the old controls: `ScreenView.boundHelpReference-9248.test.tsx` (the date bound test now reads the picker's text box) and four tests across `ScreenView.requiredMarker-10367.test.tsx`, `ScreenPreview.test.tsx`, `ScreenPreview.debugRunScope-10743.test.tsx` and `__tests__/FlowRunner.recordLink-25872.test.tsx` that clicked the checkbox synchronously now wait for the lazy control with `findByRole`. Each file imports `@object-ui/fields` at module scope per ui/AGENTS.md's 测试纪律, so the lazy factory resolves before the `findBy` budget.

## Acceptance notes

- `datetime` was a free text box before, so whatever was typed went to the flow as a string. It now writes an ISO instant, the shape the record form writes for a `datetime` field. No in-tree example declares a `datetime` screen field; the card's Expected names it.
- The boolean control is the dialog's checkbox, not the record form's switch: the card's Expected allows either, and the checkbox keeps the `role="checkbox"` every existing flow-screen test and the runner's `required` check (an unticked `false` is an answer) already read.
- The three controls are lazy, like the lookup and file arms beside them, so a test that clicks one in the same tick as the render must wait for it. The four tests above were the only ones in the flow-screen test set that did.

The required-state and help pin stays green there, as it should: the native input carried both too. Restored the same way.
